It was formed in 1986 as a [[joint venture]] between [[Mahindra & Mahindra]] and [[BT Group]]. Part of the [[Mahindra Group]], the company is headquartered in [[Pune]] and has its registered office in [[Mumbai]].{{Cite web |title=Tech Mahindra |url=http://www.techmahindra.com/en-in/ |access-date=January 1, 2018 |website=techmahindra.com |publisher=TechMahindra}} ==History== In 1986, [[Mahindra & Mahindra]] started a 60:40 [[joint venture]] technology services outsourcing firm with [[British Telecom]] named Mahindra British Telecom (MBT). In 2000, British Telecom committed business of at least £105 million over three years; as a consideration, British Telecom's stake in MBT increased to 43%.{{cite news |title=British Telecom commits Rs 7250/- million business to MBT over three years |url=https://www.rediff.com/money/2000/aug/30risc.htm |access-date=9 September 2024 |work=Rediff}} MBT primarily served the [[telecommunications industry]] in its early years, with British Telecom as its largest client.{{cite news |title=Tech Mahindra bags $700 mn deal from British Telecom |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/tech-mahindra-bags-700-mn-deal-from-british-telecom/articleshow/3044721.cms |access-date=9 September 2024 |work=The Economic Times |date=16 May 2008}} In 2006, MBT was renamed as Tech Mahindra,{{cite news |title=MBT to be renamed Tech Mahindra |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/technology/mbt-to-be-renamed-tech-mahindra-106021400031_1.html |access-date=5 September 2024 |work=Business Standard |date=14 February 2006}} and it became a [[public company|publicly-listed company]] via an [[initial public offering]].{{cite news |title=Tech Mahindra sets IPO price band at Rs 315-Rs 365 |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/tech-mahindra-sets-ipo-price-band-at-rs-315-rs-365/articleshow/1815233.cms |access-date=5 September 2024 |work=The Economic Times |date=27 July 2006}} In December 2010, British Telecom sold 5.5% of its stake in Tech Mahindra to Mahindra & Mahindra for {{INR}}451 [[crore]].{{cite web|title=BT Group to exit from Tech Mahindra, directors resign|url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2011-12-24/news/30554758_1_bt-group-tech-mahindra-techm|publisher=Economic Times|access-date=4 July 2015|date=24 December 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150705160534/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2011-12-24/news/30554758_1_bt-group-tech-mahindra-techm|archive-date=5 July 2015|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}} In August 2012, British Telecom sold 14.1% of its stake to institutional investors for about {{INR}}1,395 crore. In December 2012, British Telecom sold its remaining 9.1% stake to institutional investors for {{INR}}1,011.4 crore. This sale marked the exit of British Telecom from Tech Mahindra.{{cite web|title=BT exits Tech Mahindra|url=http://www.thehindu.com/business/companies/bt-exits-tech-mahindra/article4191751.ece|work=The Hindu|access-date=4 July 2015|date=12 December 2012}} ===Acquisition and merger of Satyam=== In the aftermath of the [[Satyam scandal]], Tech Mahindra emerged as the top bidder for a 31% controlling stake in [[Satyam Computer Services]], beating a bid from [[Larsen & Toubro]], in April 2009.{{cite web|url=http://ibnlive.in.com/news/tech-mahindra-wins-satyam-bid--full-coverage/90124-7.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090416110946/http://ibnlive.in.com/news/tech-mahindra-wins-satyam-bid--full-coverage/90124-7.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=2009-04-16|title=Tech Mahindra wins Satyam Computer bid|work=IBNLive}}{{cite news|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/headlines-today-top-stories/story/tech-mahindra-wins-satyam-bid-44197-2009-04-12|title=Tech Mahindra wins Satyam bid|website=[[India Today]]|date=12 April 2009}} After the completion of the acquisition, Satyam Computer Services was renamed Mahindra Satyam in June 2009.{{cite news |title=Satyam renamed as Mahindra Satyam |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/satyam-renamed-as-mahindra-satyam-109062200054_1.html |access-date=5 September 2024 |work=Business Standard |date=22 June 2009}} Tech Mahindra's stake in Satyam increased to 42% through a preferential share allotment in July 2009.{{cite news |title=Tech M now has 42% stake in Satyam |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/tech-m-now-has-42-stake-in-satyam-109070200032_1.html |access-date=19 July 2025 |work=Business Standard |date=2 July 2009}} [[File:Tech Mahindra Bangalore (cropped).jpg|thumb|A building in the [[Bangalore]] campus of Tech Mahindra c. 2017]] In 2010, Mahindra Satyam and [[IDEMIA|Morpho]] were awarded a contract by [[UIDAI]] to implement the [[Biometric identification by country|biometric identification system]] for the [[Aadhaar]] programme.{{cite news |title=Mahindra Satyam, Morpho selected as key partners for UIDAI |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/software/mahindra-satyam-morpho-selected-as-key-partners-for-uidai/articleshow/6238680.cms |access-date=19 July 2025 |work=The Economic Times |date=30 July 2010}} Mahindra Satyam, along with Tech Mahindra, was the official IT services provider for the [[2010 FIFA World Cup|2010]] and [[2014 FIFA World Cup]]s.{{cite news |last1=Shuey |first1=Scott |title=Mahindra Satyam gets major brand boost through World Cup |url=https://gulfnews.com/technology/mahindra-satyam-gets-major-brand-boost-through-world-cup-1.640272 |access-date=19 July 2025 |work=Gulf News |date=12 June 2010}}{{cite news |title=TechM kicked about World Cup ties |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/TechM-kicked-about-World-Cup-ties/article20799744.ece |access-date=19 July 2025 |work=BusinessLine |date=16 June 2014 |language=en}} Tech Mahindra announced its [[Mergers and acquisitions|merger]] with Mahindra Satyam on 21 March 2012, after getting approval of the two company boards.{{cite web|url=http://www.livemint.com/2012/03/21094345/Tech-Mahindra-Satyam-get-nod.html|title=Tech Mahindra, Satyam get nod to merge|url-status=dead would be led by [[Anand Mahindra]] as Chairman, [[Vineet Nayyar]] as Vice Chairman, and [[C. P. Gurnani]] as the CEO and Managing Director.{{cite web|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/business/market/story/m-satyam-tech-mahindra-hope-to-merge-in-four-weeks-166415-2013-06-10|title=M-Satyam, Tech software services company with a turnover of $2.7 billion.{{cite web|url=http://zeenews.india.com/business/news/companies/mahindra-satyam-merges-with-tech-mahindra_78656.html |title=Mahindra Satyam extract: Tech Mahindra is an Indian multinational information technology services and consulting company. It was formed in 1986 as a joint venture between Mahindra & Mahindra and BT Group. Part of the Mahindra Group, the company is headquartered in Pune and has its registered office in Mumbai.
